title: Unit-compatible restriction of ring-family models
statement: Let $F:(C,J)\to(D,L)$ be continuous and cocontinuous between small sites, let $O$ be a commutative ring sheaf on $D$, let $K,\epsilon,m$ be a specified strictly functorial augmented ring-complex family [def-weil-pbc-ring-complex-cech-data], and let $f$ be a finite list of global sections of $O$. The explicit sheafified ring-family complex [def-weil-pbc-functorial-ring-complex-sheaf] for the restricted ring and list is chain isomorphic to the restriction of the model for $O,f$. Its homomorphism takes every sheafification-unit section to its original unit section over $F(X)$. The restriction functor uses the additive module restriction interface [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheafification-restriction].

proof.text: The restricted presheaf complex is sectionwise identical to the one formed from the restricted ring and sections. Use identity component isomorphisms for that presheaf identification. Apply the module-sheafification restriction isomorphism degreewise. Its naturality for the presheaf differential gives a chain isomorphism, and unit naturality transfers its unit formula.

theorem exists_ringFamilySheafModel_restrictionIso :
    ∃ e : (ringFamilySheafModel
        ((F.sheafPushforwardContinuous CommRingCat.{u} J L).obj O)
        K ε m hm r (ringFamilyRestrictedSections F O r f)).1 ≅
      (((SheafOfModules.pushforward (F := F)
        (𝟙 ((F.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat.{u} J L).obj
          ((sheafCompose L (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O)))).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj
        (ringFamilySheafModel O K ε m hm r f).1),
      ∀ (n : ℤ) (X : Cᵒᵖ)
        (x : ((ringFamilyPresheafComplex O K ε m hm r f).X n).obj (F.op.obj X)),
        (e.hom.f n).val.app X
            (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
              (𝟙 ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj
                ((F.sheafPushforwardContinuous CommRingCat.{u} J L).obj O)).obj)).unit.app
                  ((ringFamilyPresheafComplex
                    ((F.sheafPushforwardContinuous CommRingCat.{u} J L).obj O)
                    K ε m hm r (ringFamilyRestrictedSections F O r f)).X n)).app X x) =
          (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
            (𝟙 ((sheafCompose L (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O).obj)).unit.app
              ((ringFamilyPresheafComplex O K ε m hm r f).X n)).app (F.op.obj X) x)
